en.headline: 2 commits to own repo; opened 1 docs issue on openchamber
en.summary: On 2026-10-03, sogeisetsu made 2 commits to their personal repository sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu. They also opened issue #4337 on openchamber/openchamber, reporting that the Multi-run documentation still references a sidebar header button that was removed in commit d9fbf6b and moved to the composer. No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded during this period.
